ice.text: Lim-Dul begins as a soldier who flees a battle with goblins and, caught in a blizzard, finds the ring of Mairsil among the remains of the Conclave of Mages. The ring grants him great power, so he builds Tresserhorn and becomes a necromancer, though Leshrac and Mairsil are manipulating him.

He swears himself to Leshrac, body and soul, and unleashes a horde of undead that forces old enemies to work together. He also helps Avram Garrisson form the Knights of Stromgald and poisons them when they plot a coup, zombifying them, and Kjeldor allies with the Balduvians.

Lim-Dul has Jodah captured, with Gerda trading him for the Bottomless Pit of Tresserhorn, but in the last battle he faces Jodah under Mairsil's control, and Leshrac cuts off his hand and tears him apart.

all.text: As the new climate brings floods and plagues, Lim-Dul builds an undead army bent on world domination, and the races form an alliance to defeat him. Gerda and Gustha kidnap Jodah and give him to Lim-Dul, who imprisons him in Tresserhorn and clouds his mind with Fyndhorn Pollen.

In Lim-Dul's Battle, Jaya claims his severed hand, unaware that it bears Mairsil's ring, and Jodah duels him until Leshrac cuts off his hand and takes him to Phyrexia. Mairsil's ring later coerces Jaya into picking it up, and the possessed Jaya stabs Jodah at Soldev and destroys the School of the Unseen, until Jaya ascends and expels the minds.

mbc.text: On this set's cards, Lim-Dul is the former ruler in whose stead Tresserhorn's Lord reigns.
